verdict.comment: Last year's winner Cloud Cover is respected, while VIENNOISE is an interesting alternative and Quandary has solid claims.

comments.aramisgrey: Consistent sort; ran well on this card two years ago; fighting chance off current mark
comments.biplane: Out of her depth at this level; well out of the weights
comments.brazilianrose: Has done well at Newcastle this year; form of latest effort looks strong; not ruled out
comments.callianassa: Has some good form but seems unlikely to win; still a longstanding maiden
comments.cloudcover: Useful mare; record of 7-15 on AW includes a success in this race last year; respected
comments.delicacy: Far from solid on 2025 form and is well out of the weights
comments.gaietymusical: Badly in under a penalty for Southwell win and is 0-9 over trips short of 1m
comments.heavenlyheather: Five-race maiden who appears to have no chance at this level
comments.pasha: Has shown signs that there's an AW contest in her; debut for new stable
comments.powdering: In-form 5yo; looked as good as ever the last twice; likely to be thereabouts
comments.quandary: Beat some of these rivals at Lingfield in the trial for this race; solid contender
comments.shallow: Respectable strike-rate over 6f; doesn't appear to be crying out for this new trip
comments.toomuch: Recent form includes a C&D win but this is a much tougher task
comments.viennoise: Encouraging form figures (432) for new yard; possibilities if taking well to headgear

races.raceComment: cloudcover is marginally preferred with a score of 61.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and more progressive over quandary. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 12 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 7/17 at newcastle. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments and improving, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Several runners look interesting. Top of the list is STORM STAR, ahead of Destructive.

comments.apiarist: Did well on AW this winter and the form is solid; could have more to offer
comments.brewing: Has done his winning over 6f/7f; something to prove back over 1m
comments.crackinggold: Record of 112231 on AW; had wind surgery prior to Southwell win last time; solid
comments.destructive: 3-3 since being gelded, most recently winning the trial for this race; strong claims
comments.exquisiteacclaim: Irish gelding who is 2-3 in Dundalk contests this year; stiffer task in this field
comments.fantasticfox: Finished third off 2lb higher in this event 12 months ago; each-way hopes
comments.finalvoyage: Won the Vase Mile in 2023 but he's 5lb higher in this bigger prize; headgear fitted
comments.kingdomcome: Went close off this mark in this contest last year; fighting chance
comments.nikovo: Return to Newcastle looks a plus but this is a tough assignment
comments.popmaster: Ties in with Roi De France but remains far more exposed than that rival
comments.roidefrance: Still open to further improvement and this step back up to 1m looks a plus; interesting
comments.stormstar: Solid operator who completed a C&D double in January, taking Newcastle record to 3-4
comments.symboloflight: Back in winning form the last twice, looking better than ever; not ruled out
comments.valiantforce: Irish colt who scored comfortably upped to 1m at Dundalk last time; unexposed at the trip

races.raceComment: stormstar is confidently preferred with a score of 66.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over kingdomcome. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 3/9 at newcastle. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments and improving, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Heathcliff still appeals as being ahead of his mark but FIVETHOUSANDTOONE bolted up in this race last year and can repeat the feat.

comments.apacheoutlaw: Good record on AW in Ireland; perhaps a shade high in the weights for this though
comments.badri: As good as ever this winter, badly hampered when launching his challenge latest; contender
comments.coachello: Talented on his day and could outrun his odds granted a good pace to aim at
comments.daamberdiplomat: Capable on AW & ran well after a short break last month; others look better treated though
comments.diligentharry: 2-3 over C&D, including this race in 2023; promising run at Southwell latest; new headgear
comments.fivethousandtoone: Good C&D form, including easy win in this race last year; promise all starts for new yard
comments.goldenmind: Exploited a soft lead at Kempton (6f) in February; less good over 7f since; headgear today
comments.heathcliff: Conditions to suit; in far better form than his figures suggest; still has more to offer
comments.marshman: String of good runs since gelding/wind ops, including C&D; can go well despite top weight
comments.runboyrun: Done well since cheekpieces went on; good 2nd to Marshman over C&D in January; respected
comments.saintlawrence: Uninspiring form figures but almost certainly well handicapped & latest C&D run promising
comments.thecaltonian: Admirably progressive sprinter who has conditions to suit; this looks a hot race though
comments.weneverstop: Done well on AW this winter, winning twice at Southwell; further progress required today
comments.willemtwee: Strong C&D form; capable off this mark & latest effort was eyecatching; now gets headgear

races.raceComment: weneverstop is marginally preferred with a score of 60.4%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over heathcliff. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: On the back of a useful performance over C&D, OLD HARROVIAN is taken to reverse earlier Southwell placings with Glen Buck.

comments.andaleep: Current mark gives him a difficult task in this field
comments.charlottesweb: Good effort in the trial for this contest, taking AW record to 311112; big player
comments.claymore: Balance of recent form suggests he can be opposed in this hot handicap
comments.darkmoonrising: No match for Old Harrovian when last seen; unlikely to reverse the placings
comments.dreamharder: Exposed sort who is unlikely to land this big pot
comments.glenbuck: Improving; won going away at Southwell last time, taking record to 4-5; respected
comments.hooking: Prolific French performer; creditable third off this mark in this race last year
comments.oldharrovian: Breezed clear for an easy win over C&D when last seen, taking AW record to 3-6
comments.paradias: Held off career-high mark last time; others are likely to prove better treated
comments.penzance: Good second off 1lb higher in this contest 12 months ago; again likely to go well
comments.powerofdestiny: Close third to Charlotte's Web in the Winter Oaks; still unexposed on AW
comments.salamanca: Still lightly raced and may improve on Chelmsford reappearance effort
comments.savvyvictory: Narrow success over C&D in most recent AW attempt; this looks a stiffer task
comments.smarthero: 2-2 this year, both wins at Wolverhampton; plenty in hand last time; interesting

races.raceComment: oldharrovian is marginally preferred with a score of 57.2%, holding clear edges in better ratings over glenbuck. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 3/10 at newcastle. Key attributes include positive comments, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Wonder Legend must have a chance but PLAGE DE HAVRE (nap) can reverse their Wolverhampton placings. Roaring Legend is feared.

comments.chillhi: Has been struggling for a while under both codes and he's 15lb out of the weights
comments.circuitbreaker: Has finished behind some of today's opposition in his last two races; up against it
comments.dukeofoxford: 6lb lower when runner-up in this 12 months ago but was still improving late last year
comments.heathen: Prevailed in a steadily-run 1m6f race last time; hasn't excelled over 2m in the past
comments.humblespark: Best form has been over shorter and didn't appear to stay 1m6f last time
comments.kingchaos: Has stamina to prove over this far and being 2lb out of the weights won't help
comments.midnightlion: Excellent record here; last win was at 1m2f but hasn't had many goes over this far
comments.plagedehavre: Progressive 4yo and Wonder Legend got first run when beaten by him at Wolverhampton
comments.roaringlegend: Improving having gone 3-3 since joining Hugo Palmer; hosed up in a trial for this
comments.tribalstar: Can look as though he lacks concentration in a finish and he's unraced beyond 1m4f
comments.tritonic: Hard to win with now and never dangerous back on the Flat three weeks ago at Kempton (2m)
comments.weddellsea: Seeks a hat-trick after narrow wins in two Class 5s over C&D; 8lb out of the weights
comments.wonder: Early days as a stayer and improving, but he's 4lb wrong here
comments.wonderlegend: Had the run of things at Wolverhampton last time but up just 4lb and now 3-4 on Tapeta

races.raceComment: roaringlegend is marginally preferred with a score of 65.2%, holding clear edges in more progressive over dukeofoxford. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 7/21 at newcastle. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to PARTY ISLAND who is 4-6 over C&D, is back off his last winning mark and better drawn than when seventh last year.

comments.bearaway: Three wins on AW during the winter but disappointed last time; first start for new trainer
comments.bulldogspirit: Return to this trip should suit, but he has it all to do from stall 16
comments.buxtedtoo: Eight AW wins including two over C&D, but this company may be a shade warm for him now
comments.caramay: Back off last winning mark, but all five AW wins have come on Tapeta; something to prove
comments.charlieschoice: Found to have bled when tailed off at Wolverhampton last time; something to prove
comments.civillaw: 5lb lower than when last successful, but this trip is beyond his best and drawn wide
comments.destinado: Dual winner around here and beat a big field at Doncaster last time; not opposed lightly
comments.highcourtjudge: Has enjoyed a fine 2025, but more is needed to defy this mark and drawn wider than ideal
comments.obsidianknight: Five wins around here including one over this trip; still feasibly treated and a player
comments.partyisland: Record over C&D reads 121171; back off the same mark as when winning here last May
comments.patchsbond: Beaten a short head by Tortured Soul over C&D in January; respected back over this trip
comments.raintown: 6-10 around here; his liking for this track means he has to be given an each-way shout
comments.shahbaz: 2-28 including a win at Chelmsford last time; still unproven over this far and drawn wide
comments.sundancergirl: Running well over further but is 2-2 over C&D; each-way claims granted a true pace
comments.torturedsoul: 8-17 on the AW including two wins over C&D; consistent, but drawn wider than ideal
comments.wayoflife: Dual C&D winner but losing run up to 30; will do well to break his losing run in this

verdict.comment: The choice is KIND OF KISS who ran his best race since joining his new yard when third in an even stronger contest over C&D last time.

comments.arcadiannights: 2-4 over C&D and one for the shortlist up another 3lb in his bid for the four-timer
comments.bajanbandit: Has never been this far or raced on Polytrack before; others more solid
comments.beraz: Well handicapped on his best turf form, but is 0-7 on the AW and has the outside stall
comments.cephalus: 10-24 on the AW with all wins coming over 7f/1m; may remain vulnerable over this trip
comments.hitched: Goes well here (511124); 1lb higher than when winning over C&D in January; each-way claims
comments.kindofkiss: Third of 12 in an even warmer handicap than this over C&D seven weeks ago; major player
comments.koykoy: Has since undergone wind surgery since last seen; something to prove
comments.lordsbridgeblu: Reportedly lame when behind three of these at Wolverhampton last month; bit to prove
comments.mrbaloo: A revelation on the AW this year (213111); much respected in his bid for the four-timer
comments.paradoxical: Six wins on the AW during the winter; 7lb above his last winning mark; needs to find extra
comments.rogueencore: Dual Newcastle winner in November, but beaten three times off this mark since
comments.silentage: Close fourth behind Mr Baloo and Son Of Man at Wolverhampton last time; could play a part
comments.sonofman: Only beaten half a length by Mr Baloo at Wolverhampton last time; should be thereabouts
comments.tribalwisdom: C&D winner but still 5lb above his last winning mark; others look better treated

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: The handicapper will catch up with DEMBE at some stage but he's been in the form of his life and can give it a very good shot back here.

comments.blueprince: Involved in another tight finish over 7f latest; yet to prove as effective at 1m
comments.bravozulu: Won last three 1m races by narrow margins, two over C&D; this asks for more
comments.dembe: Easy winner at Newcastle latest; 2-2 over C&D; career-high mark but good claims
comments.dingle: Suited by return to front-running when Kempton winner (1m) latest; easy lead unlikely here
comments.dragonicon: Sole win in C&D novice; running well on Tapeta until non-stayer at 1m2f since; competitive
comments.farasilane: Below best on turf latest but best Tapeta and Polytrack form puts him in the picture
comments.helmrock: Just one Polytrack win back in 2023; faded over C&D behind Dembe in January; drawn widest
comments.kalamunda: Won first five AW starts; just a shade flat over C&D latest; had short break since
comments.legalreform: Two 7f wins here; in the form of his life at Southwell of late; big trip query back at 1m
comments.longlai: One course run back in 2021; in good form without much luck in running; more to do here
comments.souslaneige: French 5yo; chance on the pick of his turf/AW form; without regular tongue-tie; drawn wide
comments.sterlingknight: In good form since 1m win at Chelmsford in December, meeting one on a roll over C&D latest

races.raceComment: dembe is marginally preferred with a score of 58.4%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over blueprince. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight polytrack bends

verdict.comment: A competitive handicap in which the frustrating but capable pair Silky Wilkie and SOMMELIER may be the two to focus on.

comments.amazoniandream: On a winning mark but lacks course experience and could prove vulnerable
comments.cajetan: Had excuses following his emphatic Class 4 win in December; perhaps vulnerable again
comments.cinqueverde: Good AW record includes a C&D win; not at her best 12 days ago; others look stronger
comments.crimsonsand: Fair stable debut at Southwell 12 days ago; fine over 6f but others look better treated
comments.diamondonthehill: Running well in defeat for new yard this year but this sharp 6f asks a different question
comments.moulinbooj: Running well but not much in hand of this mark; now tried in cheekpieces
comments.mumstipple: On a dangerous mark but the outside stall might prove an insurmountable obstacle
comments.palsbattalion: Thrived on AW since October, winning four times; no course form/wide draw the negatives
comments.princeofpillo: Easy C&D win in February; 5f too sharp latest; hood removed today; not discounted
comments.silkywilkie: Good 2nd over C&D in February; had excuses at Wolverhampton since; each-way shout
comments.sommelier: Not lived up to early promise but too much ability to discount dropped in class
comments.westmorian: Chasing a hat-trick after two easy Southwell wins; up 8lb in a better race at a new track

races.raceComment: palsbattalion is marginally preferred with a score of 57.1%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more reliable profile over westmorian. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 9 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw need consideration.

form.rpCloseUpComment: raced in last, still plenty to do when switched right over 1f out, ran on but never near to challenge (inquiry held into running and riding of gelding which raced in rear throughout before staying on strongly down  home straight from an unpromising position to finish 4th of 7 runners, beaten 2 1/4 lengths; jockey stated his instructions were to jump out, sit in box seat and see how race developed from there; he explained that gelding had missed the kick and he therefore accepted his early position and decided to sit last; he indicated that he thought the pace was decent for first 2f before it steadied up leaving back straight on first circuit leaving him further out of his ground than had been intended; from this point in race and during middle stages jockey acknowledged that he was aware pace was slow but he was reluctant to make a forward move to improve his position for fear of getting trapped wide; in explaining his riding from leaving back straight on final circuit, he stated that he was again hesitant to switch wide, due to concerns he could end up at least 4 wide around outside of runners, so committed to ride for luck down inner in hope of obtaining a clear passage between rivals on rail or to the inside of a rival if runners fanned approaching home bend, which they often do at Wolverhampton, but it failed to materialise on this occasion and he was denied clear running for some distance approaching  2f marker; on straightening for home he managed to switch gelding to outside, mounting his challenge and gelding had stayed on very well through to line; trainer confirmed instructions; however expressed disappointment that even allowing for fact that gelding wasn't quickest into stride, greater effort had not been made by rider to ensure gelding settled more prominently and was ridden to instructions; trainer also indicated that he was dissatisfied with fact that jockey failed to switch wider and improve his position on to the back of favourite for some distance from approaching 3f marker until entering home straight; jockey told stewards he was still very inexperienced riding in staying races and only had approximately 50 career rides to his name)

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Split Elevens is solid but THOMAS EQUINAS runs this track well and he's got a good draw in four. Some big players are poorly drawn.

comments.binthavanagold: In form and ran well from a wide draw here last time; stall 16 is horrible
comments.callglory: Not all doom and gloom during his losing run but this a belated first run beyond 6f
comments.capuchinero: C&D winner who went close at Wolverhampton three starts back; has a good draw
comments.charlatan: Deserves a change of luck; needs a mile ideally but a fast pace would help in that respect
comments.deltalegend: Dual winner but no closer than fifth in four runs for this one, from 1m to 1m6f
comments.foreverproud: Forgiven last run and was close up the time before; on a perfectly fair mark; new headgear
comments.harrymagnus: Dual winner for Charles Hills who has hurtled down the weights for good reason
comments.poeticforce: Hasn't won for a good while now and will do well to put that right from stall 15
comments.preferthesister: Back into a Class 6 for the first time since winning at Kempton; non-runner
comments.rhythmicacclaim: Downgraded after a good run but she's been no closer than 5l in four previous tries at 7f
comments.shotoflove: Front-runner; continues to fall in the weights but losing run is mounting up
comments.sirmaxi: Hold-up horse; Jamie Spencer a notable booking and could threaten if getting the breaks
comments.spiritlaadelita: Hasn't shown much and was 125-1 when unseating at start last time; new stable
comments.splitelevens: Multiple winner since last summer and this is his trip; another solid effort last time
comments.thomasequinas: Produced another good run here 22 days ago when reeled in late on; in the mix
comments.zurun: Last two runs have been underwhelming but he's on a perfectly good mark if bouncing back

races.raceComment: binthavanagold is marginally preferred with a score of 56.1%, holding clear edges in superior course form over splitelevens. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Kondratiev Wave can go well but bENPASSANT\p may be able to take advantage of a drop in grade and the return to 7f.

comments.amaysmont: Has won three of his last four runs here, at 6f and 7f; interesting if getting run of race
comments.antiphon: All wins at sprint trips; out of sorts this year but mark is crashing; first 7f run
comments.bellagioman: 7f winner in Ireland in 2021; better known as a sprinter now; faded back at 7f in March
comments.darkdreamer: Two 6f wins on AW and turf in 2024; well beaten for new yard; best watched on first 7f run
comments.enpassant: Off the mark on AW at Kempton (7f) then creditable 3rd over C&D; down in grade back at 7f
comments.kondratievwave: Four wins in 2024, one over C&D; has share of weight but running well; bang there
comments.lilkian: Made all over C&D this month; couldn't lead next time;  pace-setting tactics possible here
comments.lorddanielson: Both wins over 6f here; mixed 7f record but better latest; could be competitive
comments.macanudo: Course winner at 5f; handily weighted on best 2024 form; fair 4th on rare 7f run last time
comments.mashaan: Two 7f AW wins this winter; below best latest; now 9lb higher and drawn widest
comments.mymatemike: Three 7f AW wins in 2024; wouldn't enter stalls in January; pulled up over hurdles latest
comments.onceadaay: Last 3 AW wins have come on this track; 4lb lower than the latest of them but drawn wide
comments.triggered: Latest wins were four in 2023; in good form over 7f of late; can be involved again
comments.twitch: Same mark as the latest of two C&D wins in September; didn't run near best here latest
comments.venusslipper: Off the mark over 1m2f at Lingfield in February; poor turf run latest; squeak back on AW
comments.windsorpass: Two good C&D runs in January, beating Mashaan in the 2nd; needs race to go her way

races.raceComment: kondratievwave is marginally preferred with a score of 58.0%, holding clear edges in more reliable profile over onceadaay. Placed in 4 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: The impeccably bred DON SIMON (nap) looks interesting now raised in distance under Ryan Moore as his comeback run was encouraging.

comments.alrightsunshine: Multiple winner but an exposed 10yo who doesn't arrive here in the best of form
comments.caballodemar: Has another 6lb rise to deal with here but won cosily last time and he's on a roll
comments.cardano: Has become inconsistent and it was a messy race in which he prevailed at Wolverhampton
comments.cello: Has knocked on the door a few times but it's hard to call him well handicapped
comments.clansman: Loves the mud and he's 0-4 on the AW; struggled badly during the second half of last year
comments.cockandbull: Slow starts are holding him back and stall 1 could spell danger with that in mind
comments.donsimon: Improved second on reappearance; should stay this far and Ryan Moore is booked
comments.javaraja: Disappointing favourite on handicap debut and will have to step up on that
comments.knockbrex: Kept on for fourth over 1m4f last time and well worth another go over this far
comments.liamswagger: Capable Flat horse (fine on Polytrack) and third in the Fred Winter at Cheltenham latest
comments.rakki: Maiden under both codes but nearly won over 1m6f at Sandown last summer
comments.simiyann: His only wins (both at Wolverhampton) came in 1m6f/2m Class 6 handicaps
comments.sixpack: Consistent dual winner in Ireland and left Johnny Murtagh for 52,000gns
comments.steeltiger: He doesn't look unrealistically handicapped provided he stays this far (not bred to)
comments.sugarloaflenny: Last year he won three times at up to 1m4f and could be that he needed his comeback race
